Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for all work in this repository. Summary:

- The spec in `docs/spec/` is authoritative; MUST = approved obligation, PROPOSED = unvalidated default or target.
- Cite requirement IDs and update `docs/spec/traceability.md`.
- One session = one branch = one PR; layer N is based on layer N-1. Open ready PRs; never merge.
- Use Conventional Commits.
- Never commit private vault/X data, credentials, or tokens. Synthetic fixtures only.
- Do not claim anything is implemented or tested without code and passing tests.
